title: Make public projects safer: keep outsiders' comments from agents, warn on connect and before recording
summary: On a public project, agents now read comments through commands that leave outsiders' comments out, and an organisation member not in the project no longer counts as a collaborator. Connecting a public repository shows the public warning, and the consent script says the transcript is public.

deferred.what: On a public organisation project, an organisation member with repository access who is not in .grillo/members.json on main (access through a team, opened an already-connected project without a Grillo invite, or their line is still waiting in a pull request on a protected main, the connecting member included) has their comments and answers ignored, with no message saying why.
deferred.why: The review's fail-closed fix leaves this by design, and a join step or message is outside this issue.
